uf-hsa-vaccine.criteria: Splenic primary required; doxorubicin after splenectomy. A primary heart/other site is not accepted.

tufts-hsa-liquid.criteria: Splenic primary required with no obvious spread; HSA in heart/other primary site does not qualify.

ethos-epush-hsa.criteria: Entry before splenectomy for ruptured splenic tumor. Primary splenic location and planned surgery are required; published bounds are strictly >5 and <45kg.

au-melbourne-hsa-autologous-vaccine-mult.criteria: MediPaws primary eligibility: confirmed splenic HSA, completed splenectomy, no visible metastasis before chemotherapy, planned doxorubicin. The autologous vaccine is adjunctive.

jhu-cigat-brain-rt-tmz-2026.criteria: Published protocol combines five consecutive weekdays of radiation with concurrent oral temozolomide. Both radiation and chemotherapy must be acceptable.

ethos-solid-relapse.criteria: Cytologically confirmed relapsed nodal lymphoma after original Ethos-SOLID/CHOP enrollment. Relapse and further chemotherapy are required; unknown original-trial history remains prescreening.

purdue-hifu-lymphoma.criteria: Primary body explicitly says dogs have not yet received chemotherapy and all receive CHOP after HIFU. Untreated newly diagnosed lymphoma excludes known prior chemotherapy and reported relapse; prior steroids still follow published washout/team review.

jp-nihon-proteasome-inhibitor-b-cell-tum.criteria: Primary requires confirmed B-cell lymphoid neoplasm. A known T-cell/other lymphoma subtype must not pass from the generic Lymphoma — other choice; non-lymphoma diagnoses ignore a stale hidden lymphoma-type answer.

aurelius-lytix-bcell-lymphoma.criteria: Published primary criteria require previously untreated stage III–V(a) B-cell lymphoma. Known prior lymphoma chemotherapy, tumor radiation or immunotherapy contradict untreated status.

china-petcura-personalized-mrna-iit-2026.criteria: Primary explicitly excludes T-cell lymphoma and brain tumors. Enforce known T-cell phenotype even when the main diagnosis is Lymphoma — other or cutaneous epitheliotropic lymphoma; ignore hidden phenotype for non-lymphoma diagnoses.
